channel.title: The Apprentice
channel.desc: It's the final, and after 12 tough weeks, the last two candidates standing must go head-to-head in a battle to win Lord Sugar's investment. Supported by returning candidates, the finalists must launch their businesses to a roomful of industry experts and some legends from the last 20 years. In the boardroom, Lord Sugar decides who will become his next business partner.
